title: MCP server for farm-surveillance system API + per-alert event.json artifact
context: Gate-alert split: the outer-loop agent (separate repo, MCP client) needs a stable API into the inner-loop pipeline (this repo). This PRD lands the inner side of that seam: a typed system API (camera + events + gate + cooldown + identity + listener + telegram + vision + config resources), exposed via streamable-HTTP MCP with bearer-token auth, plus a per-alert event.json record so the outer agent can audit history without re-deriving it. Behavioral change to pipeline.run() = none. Existing tests must continue passing.
shipping_definition: infra/farm_api.py: typed Python functions for 9 resource groups (cameras, events, gate, cooldowns, identities, listener, telegram, vision, config). Pure functions, no transport awareness, dataclass in/out.

infra/mcp_server.py: streamable-HTTP MCP server, bearer-token auth, /healthz endpoint, binds to Tailscale interface by default. Each MCP tool is a 3-line adapter over a farm_api function. Tools: list_cameras, get_camera_health, get_camera_snapshot, list_events, get_event, get_gate_config, list_suppression_rules, list_active_cooldowns, list_known_people/vehicles/animals, get_listener_status, get_recent_errors, get_telegram_status, get_vision_status, get_config.
Every tool response includes a `box_id` field (defaults to hostname) so a multi-box outer agent can namespace responses without ambiguity.
pipeline.run() writes data/events/<alert_id>/event.json per alert (atomic write: .tmp + fsync + rename).
docs/API.md: full contract for every resource — input schema, output schema, freshness guarantee, error cases. The 'what'.
docs/MCP-API.md: MCP-specific — tool names, JSON schemas, transport details, auth, cross-box discovery. The 'how'.
All 178 existing unit tests + 17 existing e2e tests continue to pass. No behavioral change to alerts reaching Telegram.
FARMSURV_MCP_ENABLED=1 (1=ON, 0=OFF, default 0). Opt-in. Launchd plist unchanged (operator rule: zero env vars in plist).
FARMSURV_MCP_BIND=tailnet-only (default; binds to 100.64.0.0/10 Tailscale interface). Override to 0.0.0.0 only with operator approval.
FARMSURV_MCP_TOKEN required at server start (32+ char random; abort if missing or weak).
FARMSURV_BOX_ID defaults to $(hostname); override only for testing.
design_principles: API-first, MCP second. infra/farm_api.py is the load-bearing contract. The MCP server is one transport adapter; future REST/CLI/gRPC adapters can reuse the same functions.
One resource group = one story. Smaller chunks for review, rollback, and troubleshooting. Each story is 'add N functions + N tests, no behavior change'.
Read-only in this PRD. Write tools (mute camera, enroll identity, set cooldown, restart listener) ship in V2-069. Outer agent cannot mutate state through MCP yet.

MCP server is a separate process from the listener. It reads from data/events/ and ring buffers; it does NOT call pipeline.run() live. Stale-by-design (last 24h of events) so it cannot accidentally re-trigger alerts.
Streamable-HTTP transport, not stdio. Stdio only works when client + server share a process tree. Cross-box needs HTTP.
Bearer-token auth. Tailscale-bound by default (port unreachable from LAN unless operator overrides). TLS is operator's responsibility if exposing beyond tailnet.
Multi-box aware. box_id in every response. Outer agent's job to namespace; server's job to identify.
Stdlib only. No Pydantic. No new runtime dependency. Dataclasses for in-memory, JSON Schema in MCP tool descriptions for the wire.

stories.title: Write per-alert event.json in pipeline.run()
scope: New module infra/event_record.py: EventRecord dataclass + write_event_record(alert_id, camera_id, stage_results) function

EventRecord fields: alert_id (str), camera_id (str), box_id (str), started_at (ISO8601), finished_at (ISO8601), gate (GateVerdict | None), vm1 (Vm1Result | None), vm2 (dict | None), match (MatchResult | None), dropped (str | None), frame_paths (list[Path]), artifact_dir (Path)
pipeline.run() calls write_event_record() once per alert, after the final stage (whether dropped or fully sent)
Output path: data/events/<alert_id>/event.json
Atomic write: write to .tmp, fsync, rename — same pattern as existing JSONL audit
tests: Existing pipeline tests must continue to pass; event.json is a new side-effect, not a behavioral change

stories.title: farm_api: Cameras resource
scope: Dataclasses: CameraInfo (camera_id, display_name, model, rtsp_url_redacted, ip_redacted), CameraHealth (camera_id, online, last_frame_at, rtsp_errors_last_24h)
list_cameras() -> list[CameraInfo]: read from infra/paths.py + camera-creds.env metadata
get_camera_health(camera_id) -> CameraHealth | None: read listener health data (initially stub from filesystem; refined in 068b6)
get_camera_snapshot(camera_id) -> Path | None: latest frame in data/frames/<camera>/
Redact IPs in CameraInfo output (replace 192.168.x.x with [REDACTED-LAN-IP])

stories.title: farm_api: Events resource
scope: Reuse EventRecord dataclass from infra/event_record.py (068a)
list_events(camera_id=None, since=None, limit=50) -> list[EventRecord]: walk data/events/*/event.json, newest first, optional filter
get_event(event_id) -> EventRecord | None: read single file
Return dataclass instances; never raw dicts

stories.title: farm_api: Gate resource
scope: Dataclasses: GateConfig (motion_threshold, night_suppress_enabled, global_change_max_pct), SuppressionRule (camera_id, class_name, reason, expires_at)
get_gate_config() -> GateConfig: read relevant env vars via os.environ
list_suppression_rules() -> list[SuppressionRule]: read from gate's runtime state (initially empty list if no state file exists)

stories.title: farm_api: Cooldowns resource
scope: Dataclass: Cooldown (camera_id, class_name, expires_at, set_by, reason)
list_active_cooldowns() -> list[Cooldown]: read from pipeline state if exposed, else empty list
If pipeline state not yet exposed: return [] and log a TODO. Write tool ships in V2-069 anyway.

stories.title: farm_api: Known identities resource
scope: Dataclasses: PersonIdentity (name, enrolled_at, last_seen_at, photo_count), VehicleIdentity (label, make, model, color, owner, enrolled_at), AnimalIdentity (species, name, enrolled_at)
list_known_people() / list_known_vehicles() / list_known_animals(): read from data/known_people/, data/known_vehicles/, data/known_animals/
Use the canonical store classes (no raw JSON reads)

stories.title: farm_api: Listener status resource
scope: Dataclasses: ListenerStatus (pid, uptime_seconds, mode, started_at, last_event_at), ErrorRecord (timestamp, severity, message, source)
get_listener_status() -> ListenerStatus: read pidfile + boot log line
get_recent_errors(n=20) -> list[ErrorRecord]: tail logs/daemon.log, parse ERROR lines
Refine get_camera_health (from 068b1) to pull from listener status if available

stories.title: farm_api: Telegram status resource
scope: Dataclass: TelegramStatus (chat_id_redacted, last_send_at, last_send_status, errors_last_24h)
get_telegram_status() -> TelegramStatus: read from logs/daemon.log Telegram section
Redact chat_id in output (replace digits with [REDACTED-CHAT-ID])

stories.title: farm_api: Vision status resource
scope: Dataclass: VisionStatus (model_name, base_url_redacted, queue_depth, last_call_latency_ms, calls_last_24h)
get_vision_status() -> VisionStatus: read from infra/vision_analyzer.py module-level state if exposed; else env + a heartbeat file the analyzer writes
If too much work to expose runtime state: return env-only shape for now, runtime fields = None. Document the gap.

stories.title: farm_api: Config view resource
scope: Dataclass: ConfigView (env: dict[str, str], knobs_documented: list[str], knobs_set: list[str], knobs_missing: list[str])
get_config() -> ConfigView: read ~/.env, parse, diff against .env.example
SECRETS REDACTED: any knob matching /token|password|key|secret/i shows [REDACTED] in value, name preserved
List of known-safe knobs to surface: GATE_*, FARMSURV_*, MOTION_*, VISION_*, LISTEN_*. Others excluded.

stories.title: MCP server: streamable-HTTP, bearer auth, adapters over farm_api
scope: streamable-HTTP MCP server (mcp package or stdlib shim), default port 8091
Bearer-token auth: middleware checks Authorization header against FARMSURV_MCP_TOKEN; reject with HTTP 401 if missing or wrong
/healthz endpoint: HTTP 200 + {ok: true, box_id, uptime_seconds, mcp_enabled}
Binds to 100.64.0.0/10 (Tailscale CGNAT range) by default via FARMSURV_MCP_BIND=tailnet-only; refuses to bind to 0.0.0.0 unless operator overrides (log a loud warning if so)
Each tool: 3-line adapter — @mcp.tool() decorator, call farm_api.X(), return dataclass.asdict() + {box_id: ...}
Tool name = function name (camelCase in JSON Schema, snake_case in Python — the decorator handles it)
Standalone runnable: `python -m infra.mcp_server` starts the server (for MCP client to spawn)
FARMSURV_MCP_TOKEN required: abort at startup if missing or shorter than 32 chars (warn operator to generate one via `python -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))'`)

stories.title: Document API + MCP contracts
scope: docs/API.md: for every resource — input schema, output schema, freshness guarantee, error cases, secrets-redacted examples

docs/MCP-API.md: MCP-specific — tool name → API function mapping, JSON Schema, transport (streamable-HTTP), auth flow (bearer token, /healthz), multi-box discovery (operator-side config in outer-loop repo), cross-reference to gate-alert/docs/original-design-discussion.md
Include 'do not call from outer agent' section: list of things outer MUST NOT do (call live pipeline, mutate files, restart listener, bypass write-tool guardrail until V2-069)
Cross-reference V2-069 (write tools) as the next extension

blocks: V2-069 (MCP write tools — outer-loop can mute/enroll/set-cooldown/restart)
estimated_complexity: medium — 12 stories, but each is small. Pattern is: dataclass + 1-3 functions + 1-3 tests, repeated 9 times for resources, then a thin MCP adapter, then docs. No behavioral change to live pipeline at any step.
